# Golden fixtures

Files produced by the Java implementation of Arma3Sync. Rust must decode them and re-encode them
byte-identically (after gunzip).

| Directory | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `java_repos/wog_ftp/` | `.a3s/` metadata of the public "Weekly Open Games" repository, `ftp://88.99.69.243/Repo/WOG/.a3s/` (revision 55, fetched 2026-10-10). |
| `java_built/` | Sample repositories built by the real Java builder (HTTP/FTP × plain/zip, 3 build steps each), plus uploaded metadata and events sessions. `scenario.json` / `generated_files.json` hold inputs and mtimes. |
| `java_local/` | Java client data: `a3s.cfg`, `a3s.prefs`, `*.a3s.profile`, encrypted `*.a3s.repository` (+ plain copies), `export.a3s.autoconfig`. |
| `java_presets/` | Arma 3 Launcher HTML presets written by the Java exporter. |
| `java_roundtrip/` | Java deserialize→serialize round trips (collection capacities, string sharing). |
| `java_descriptors.txt` | Class descriptors (UIDs, flags, fields) of every serialized class, from JDK 25. |
| `java_harness_manifest.txt` | SHA-256 of every generated file. |

Everything except `java_repos/` is generated by `tools/java_fixture_harness`
(see its README). Regenerate with
`scripts/gate.sh cargo run -p a3s_dev_tools -- regen-fixtures --write-fixtures` and check
with `... -- regen-fixtures --check` (needs `source scripts/java_env.sh`).
